mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns following FEDFUNDS declines are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.3pp or Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate housing sector contraction, which precedes broader economic weakness and drives negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of cases when both RSAFS and HOUST decline or interaction term is insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing contraction (INDPRO < 100) signals an economic slowdown phase, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during INDPRO < 100 periods or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2.0%) indicates robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 > 2.0% or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) signals potential monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as risk appetite declines.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of cases when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% or Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market deterioration, triggering sharp equity sell-offs over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >50% of cases when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises or interaction term is insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing market booms (HOUST > 1300 thousand units) fuel consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST > 1300 or Rank IC < 0.03.
